header: GET /api/history-docs/<id> a plant document the DSP history card cites (a JO Manual), shown in the browser; signed-in readers only GET /api/history-docs/<id>?info=1 {title, pages, bytes} as JSON (what the card's viewer asks first, to know whether to show the PDF or the Sign in button) The work is done in src/tools/dsphistory/serve.ts; scripts/upload-history-docs.mjs puts the files in Vercel Blob.
